holdout_payload_style.description: Train: benign-train + attacks of the other 4 styles. Test: benign-test + all attacks of the held-out style. Payload-style holdout, NOT a family holdout.

holdout_attack_family.description: For each fold, train on benign training sessions and all other attack families; test on benign test sessions plus the held-out attack family. This is a family holdout.

anomaly_benign_only.description: Fitted on benign sessions of the training tasks only; threshold = 0.95 quantile of their anomaly scores (target FPR about 5%). No attack data used for fitting or thresholds.

headline.why: no task is in both train and test, so seed-level near-duplicates cannot be memorised
